caption: The drawing features two plates, one colored and decorated and one below it sketched in outline. The colored plate, which is oval, has a dark, nearly black background. The central motif on this plate is a still life with a wooden cutting board holding a variety of food items and a small glass. On the cutting board, there are two red tomatoes, a cluster of green and purple grapes, a wedge of lettuce or leafy greens, and a greenish glass containing a light-colored liquid. The border of the plate consists of a repeating pattern using yellow, orange, and white geometric shapes and dots. Beneath the colored plate is a line drawing of a similar plate, showing the same oval shape and border pattern without any central decoration or color. The drawing is signed in the bottom right corner, and there is a handwritten note at the lower left that reads, "Scale = 1/2 original size."
title: Tray
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
